name: Symmetric successive relaxation sweep
variables: A symmetric matrix; D,L,U splitting; ω fixed relaxation; y forward sweep
assumptions: SPD A, 0<ω<2, fixed ordering, finite precision monitored.
limitations: Two sequential sweeps; not necessarily faster than forward SOR.
failure_conditions: Zero diagonal, invalid relaxation or residual stagnation
computation: Apply forward and reversed relaxed triangular sweeps; check true residual.

name: Chebyshev polynomial linear iteration
definition: For SPD A with spectrum in [a,b], 0<a<b, let d=(a+b)/2, c=(b−a)/2 and q_k(t)=T_k((d−t)/c)/T_k(d/c). The kth iterate is x_k=x*+q_k(A)(x₀−x*); compute using the polynomial recurrence on the initial residual without knowing x*.
variables: a,b spectral bounds; T_k Chebyshev polynomial; x* exact solution; q_k normalized error polynomial
assumptions: Valid positive enclosing spectral interval; stable recurrence and residual checks.
limitations: Poor bounds degrade convergence; no guarantee for general nonsymmetric matrices.
failure_conditions: Invalid interval, nonfinite recurrence or residual tolerance failure
computation: Use normalized three-term polynomial recurrence and matrix-vector products; derive an implementable residual recurrence before admission.

source.citation: Barrett et al., Templates for the Solution of Linear Systems, §2.3.9; verify polynomial normalization and recurrence before admission. https://netlib.org/templates/templates.html

required_inputs: Operator, right side, initial vector, spectral bounds, stopping criteria.
incompatible_methods: Using unverified spectral bounds as guaranteed
mechanism_note: Provisional predetermined polynomial coefficients versus adaptive Krylov coefficients; assess equivalence to existing momentum methods.
